findings.summary: Salary calculation imports an unnamed subset of the interactive salary-research prompt instead of a bounded reusable benchmark contract.

assessment.reason: The current read-only warning already prevents intentionally restarting research, and no incorrect result was established. A named reusable boundary would modestly reduce the burden of locating scattered requirements and maintaining their Step 4 restatement; the extra resource/read edge must justify its cost.
evidence: Project guidance in AGENTS.md keeps orchestration in workflows, step behavior in prompts and reusable rules in explicitly loaded flat skills references; this is a project convention, not a framework requirement.

prompts/salary-calculator/step1-research-prompt-generator.md:18 mixes local-employee benchmark scope with employment-path questions; lines 36–49 and 71–90 spread tier, pay-basis, geography/hours and source/method requirements through research instructions and the answer format.

prompts/salary-calculator/step4-table-calculation.md:26 selectively imports only benchmark-scope and benchmark-metadata requirements from Step 1 without named section boundaries, then repeats its comparability checklist. Maintainers must preserve that selective edge whenever these shared requirements change.

prompts/salary-calculator/step5b-final-verification.md:5–9 consumes saved benchmark context and loads Step 4 as the canonical calculation procedure. Existing arithmetic, field formats, question ownership and validation contracts remain intentional.
assessment.invariant: Preserve both independently researched local-employee employer tiers, original research field names and answer format, literal self-contained researcher briefs, role/level/geography/hours/pay/source-method comparability, recoverable legacy metadata without invention or stricter ingestion, qualification and skip rules, question order and choices, checkpoints, profile/state schemas and generated outputs. Keep country selection/research orchestration in Step 1 and calculation eligibility in Step 4.
